name: christianpure-pauls-journeys
title: Paul's missionary journeys: stops, legs and places
description: Every stop on Paul's three missionary journeys and his voyage to Rome, in order, with coordinates, the verse in Acts, distances by Roman road and by sea, heights, and the days Acts gives. The data behind the Christian Pure map at https://christianpure.com/pauls-missionary-journeys/.

sources.title: Itiner-e: the digital atlas of ancient roads, 2024, Brughmans, Pažout, de Soto and Bjerregaard Vahlstrup (CC BY 4.0)
Terrain Tiles on AWS (SRTM, GMTED2010, ETOPO1, EU-DEM/Copernicus)

resources.name: journeys
resources.title: Journeys
resources.description: One row per journey, with total distances.

fields.name: journey_id
fields.description: Short id of the journey: first, second, third or rome.

fields.name: journey_order
fields.description: Order of the journey, 1 to 4.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the journey.

fields.name: bible_refs
fields.description: The chapters of Acts the journey covers.

fields.name: bible_refs_osis
fields.description: The same range in OSIS notation.

fields.name: years
fields.description: Approximate years, as scholars reconstruct them.

fields.name: stop_count
fields.description: Number of stops (rows in stops.csv).

fields.name: leg_count
fields.description: Number of legs (rows in legs.csv).

fields.name: road_km
fields.description: Kilometres on Roman roads (Itiner-e network), all legs.

fields.name: drawn_km
fields.description: Kilometres of straight line drawn where a place lies off the road network.

fields.name: sea_km
fields.description: Kilometres by sea, all legs.

fields.name: total_km
fields.description: road_km + drawn_km + sea_km.

resources.name: stops
resources.title: Stops
resources.description: One row per stop, in order, with coordinates and verse.

fields.name: journey_id
fields.description: Journey (journeys.csv).

fields.name: stop_order
fields.description: Order of the stop within its journey, from 1.

fields.name: stop_id
fields.description: Id of the stop, unique within its journey. A place visited twice has a suffix such as -2.

fields.name: place_id
fields.description: Place (places.csv).

fields.name: label
fields.description: Name shown on the map. Where Acts names a region, the region.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: stop: Acts has Paul stop or work here. pass: passed or touched on the way. reading: Acts names a region or leaves the place open, and the place is our reading.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: WGS 84 latitude of the place.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: WGS 84 longitude of the place.

fields.name: bible_ref
fields.description: The verse in Acts (or a letter) that puts Paul here.

fields.name: bible_ref_osis
fields.description: The same verse in OSIS notation.

fields.name: verse_text
fields.description: Text of bible_ref in the World English Bible (public domain).

fields.name: note
fields.description: Our one-line note on what happens here. Empty for some passing stops.

fields.name: also_refs
fields.description: Other verses for this stop, separated by "; ". Their texts are in stop-verses.csv.

fields.name: letter_ref
fields.description: A verse from one of Paul’s letters that recalls this visit, if any.

fields.name: letter_ref_osis
fields.description: The same verse in OSIS notation.

fields.name: letter_text
fields.description: Text of letter_ref in the World English Bible.

fields.name: letter_why
fields.description: Our note on how the letter connects to the visit.

fields.name: letter_is_reading
fields.description: true where the link between letter and visit rests on a disputed reading.

resources.name: stop-verses
resources.title: Stop verses
resources.description: Every verse quoted for a stop, one per row.

fields.name: journey_id
fields.description: Journey (journeys.csv).

fields.name: stop_order
fields.description: Stop (stops.csv), by its order in the journey.

fields.name: stop_id
fields.description: Id of the stop.

fields.name: role
fields.description: main: the stop’s own verse. also: another verse for the stop. letter: a verse from a letter.

fields.name: bible_ref
fields.description: Bible reference.

fields.name: bible_ref_osis
fields.description: The same reference in OSIS notation.

fields.name: text
fields.description: Text in the World English Bible (public domain). Some are part of a verse.

resources.name: legs
resources.title: Legs
resources.description: One row per leg between two stops, with distances and heights.

fields.name: journey_id
fields.description: Journey (journeys.csv).

fields.name: leg_order
fields.description: Order of the leg within its journey, from 1. Leg n runs from stop n to stop n+1.

fields.name: from_stop_id
fields.description: Stop the leg starts from.

fields.name: to_stop_id
fields.description: Stop the leg ends at.

fields.name: from_place_id
fields.description: Place the leg starts from.

fields.name: to_place_id
fields.description: Place the leg ends at.

fields.name: from_label
fields.description: Name of the start.

fields.name: to_label
fields.description: Name of the end.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: How the leg is travelled: road, sea, or foot (Acts 20:13, where Paul walks while the ship sails round). A sea leg may begin or end with a short road part.

fields.name: road_km
fields.description: Kilometres on the Itiner-e Roman road network.

fields.name: drawn_km
fields.description: Kilometres of straight line joining a place to the network.

fields.name: sea_km
fields.description: Kilometres of our drawn sea line.

fields.name: total_km
fields.description: road_km + drawn_km + sea_km.

fields.name: days_on_foot
fields.description: Land kilometres divided by 29.6 km a day (20 Roman miles, Vegetius 1.9). Empty for legs wholly at sea. An assumption, not a record.

fields.name: climb_m
fields.description: Metres climbed on the land part.

fields.name: descent_m
fields.description: Metres descended on the land part.

fields.name: highest_m
fields.description: Highest point of the land part, in metres.

fields.name: road_certain_km
fields.description: Road kilometres that Itiner-e grades certain. Empty where the leg has no road.

fields.name: road_conjectured_km
fields.description: Road kilometres that Itiner-e grades conjectured.

fields.name: road_hypothetical_km
fields.description: Road kilometres that Itiner-e grades hypothetical.

fields.name: itinere_roads
fields.description: Names of the Itiner-e road segments used, in order, separated by "; ".

fields.name: acts_days
fields.description: Days Acts itself gives for this stretch, if any.

fields.name: acts_days_approximate
fields.description: true where the days are not a stated journey time (the storm before Malta).

fields.name: acts_days_from_stop_id
fields.description: Where the days in Acts are counted from, which can be an earlier stop.

fields.name: acts_ref
fields.description: The verse that gives the days.

fields.name: acts_ref_osis
fields.description: The same verse in OSIS notation.

fields.name: acts_quote
fields.description: That verse in the World English Bible.

resources.name: places
resources.title: Places
resources.description: One row per place, with the records it is matched to.

fields.name: place_id
fields.description: Id of the place.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the place as first labelled on the map.

fields.name: on_route
fields.description: false for Tarsus, Paul’s home city, which the map marks but no journey stops at.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: WGS 84 latitude, from OpenBible.info.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: WGS 84 longitude, from OpenBible.info.

fields.name: openbible_id
fields.description: Id of the OpenBible.info ancient place record the point comes from.

fields.name: openbible_name
fields.description: Name of that OpenBible.info record.

fields.name: openbible_identification
fields.description: The modern site OpenBible.info identifies the place with.

fields.name: openbible_other_candidate_sites
fields.description: How many other candidate sites OpenBible.info lists.

fields.name: wikidata_id
fields.description: Wikidata item, from OpenBible.info.

fields.name: pleiades_id
fields.description: Pleiades place matched to the point, if one lies near. Empty where none matched.

fields.name: pleiades_title
fields.description: Title of the Pleiades place.

fields.name: pleiades_offset_km
fields.description: Kilometres between the OpenBible.info point and the Pleiades point.

fields.name: pleiades_url
fields.description: Address of the Pleiades place.

resources.name: stops-geojson
resources.title: Stops as GeoJSON
resources.description: The stops as points, with the fields of stops.csv and their other verses.

resources.name: legs-geojson
resources.title: Legs as GeoJSON
resources.description: The legs as lines (one MultiLineString per leg, one line per road or sea part), with the fields of legs.csv.
